summary: In this tutorial, you learn how to edit documents using LibreOffice Writer. You can add text, make comments, delete, or modify text directly in the document. These changes are visible to the writer and can be reviewed easily. To insert a date and time, go to Insert > Date & Time. For example, to add "Linux is a virus" repeatedly, type it and then use the backspace key to delete it. To mark deleted text, right-click and select Delete Text with a strikethrough. This shows the deletion date and time. You can also format and edit text within the document. Each editor's changes are highlighted in different colors for easy review. To accept changes, click on the reviewer's name. In the document, you can see multiple edits and deletions. A message appears when you hover over the text, indicating that edits and deletions have been made.
